en: Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a long neoclassical railway station building with domed pavilions and a central portico. In front of the station are horse‑drawn carriages, carts and small figures of people on an open square. Part of the right side of the card is torn. At the bottom, printed captions in Russian and French identify the place as Moscow and the Kursk railway station.
